entities.name: Venkat Dasai
entities.description: Human former Consulate enforcer who defected to the Renegades and became their commander.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane where the Consulate and Renegades clash.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Oppressive authority of Avishkar with guard forces.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Renegade leader and artificer who trusts Venkat.

entities.name: Tamni
entities.description: Fresh renegade artificer who helped form a thopter squad.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Person Pia mistook for Venkat when she was arrested.

events.summary: Venkat has a crisis of conscience over unjust arrests and leaves the Consulate to live as a private citizen.
events.quote: Disenchanted, Venkat left the Consulate to live as a private citizen.

events.summary: Venkat contacts radical renegades and organizes the sabotage and supply raids that made Pia and her fellow resisters infamous.
events.quote: started using his military training to organize the sabotage and supply raids

events.summary: Venkat joins Pia as she hosts Tamni and other new renegade artificers forming a thopter squad.
events.quote: He joined her when they hosted Tamni and several other fresh renegade artificers in forming a squad of thopters .

events.summary: Venkat leaves Pia in a different direction; Pia is arrested soon after and thinks Tezzeret is Venkat sneaking up on her.
events.quote: she thought Tezzeret was Venkat sneaking up on her again

relations.quote: He has a deep trust in Pia, and she in him
who switched sides from the Consulate to the Renegades
